body.objective: If minimal kinetic braiding has no viable locus, classify the smallest shift-symmetric Horndeski/DHOST curvature coupling that changes the trace and lapse constraints without introducing an Ostrogradsky scalar.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal kinetic-braiding coefficient-locus theorem.  Proceed only if it exports no passing selected action.  Declare the complete lowest-order dressed-metric Level-3 action with quadratic P(X) and one minimal G4(X)R_hat plus G4X[(Box_hat theta)^2-(nabla_hat_mu nabla_hat_nu theta)^2] combination, setting the Level-2 braiding term to zero so mechanisms remain separated.  Derive the degeneracy matrix and full action-origin BV unary data, both background Euler systems, scalar/tensor principal symbols, constraint ranks, reduced velocity/gradient pairing, characteristic roots, charges and relational-clock inequalities.  Use exact elimination to classify every coefficient stratum and rank-change surface.  Export a selected action only after all seven gates pass, or a complete scoped Level-3 no-go with the first invariant separator.
body.forbid: no combination with the failed braiding sector before this mechanism is isolated; no generic DHOST scan without a declared complete ansatz; no equation-order counting called degeneracy; no gauge fixing used to hide a physical scalar; no numerical sample called a viable component; no nonlinear or quantum promotion before classical gates pass
activates: one selected Level-3 action and causal carrier
or the exact Level-3 no-go activating an independent geometric gauge variable
body.resource_hint: CLASSICAL LEVEL 3.  Isolate one degenerate curvature mechanism after Level 2 is terminal.
notes: If Level 2 passes, this item should be retired rather than combined automatically.
